description: Maintenance view of what HexaCore has learned: resolved failures without a lesson yet (with recurrence counts), lessons whose evidence says they are not helping (rewrite with record_lesson updateId, or retire), near-duplicate lessons to merge (merge_lessons), lessons unused for months (still accurate?), proven lessons ready to export as skills or share with your other projects, the most effective lessons, and the lesson library from your other projects. With query, searches project and library lessons.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.
